# AudioGroup

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("AudioGroup")`

A mixing bus. The volume of every `Sound` whose `Group` is this group is multiplied by the group's `Volume`, so one property turns down all the music or all the effects.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Volume` | `number` | `1` | read/write | A multiplier on the volume of the group's sounds. 0 is silent, 1 is unchanged, and a value above 1 is louder and can clip. Groups do not nest: a group parented to another group is not affected by it. |
